mapper.select:
SELECT d.id, d.prj_id AS prjId, d.mem_id AS memId,
u.name || '(' || u.login || ')' AS memName,
d.title, d.description, d.created_on AS createdOn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTACHMENTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = '07MODULE' AND CONTAINER_ID = d.id) AS file_count FROM document d LEFT JOIN users u ON d.mem_id = u.id WHERE d.prj_id = #{prjId} ORDER BY d.id DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT document_seq.nextval FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO document ( id, prj_id, mem_id, title, description, created_on ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{prjId}, #{memId}, #{title}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
